key_insight: A decoder-agnostic diagnostic layer distinguishes detectable check violations, harmless stabilizer residuals, and syndrome-silent logical errors in stabilizer codes.
engineering_relevance: The software layer can supplement existing quantum error-correction decoders without additional physical qubits and compare the relative logical class of record-compatible correction candidates online.
method: Construct a nilpotent supercharge whose clean degree-zero harmonic sector is the code space.
Use projected-return tests to identify syndromes where a chosen correction preserves every encoded input across a declared error family.
Translate the construction into an exact binary residual-class diagnostic, with a two-sector form for CSS codes.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports verification on the Steane code and specifies, rather than reports results from, a static–circuit bridge audit for the Gross bivariate-bicycle qLDPC code.
watch_item: Faithfulness certification is conditional on the declared same-syndrome error family; broader circuit-level performance is not established in the abstract.
paper_title: Logical-Class Diagnostic Layer for Stabilizer Codes and Decoders via Supercharge Structures
